decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 10A Maple Grove].

Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the eastern elevation of the 'turret' and the in the side dormer roof extension shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extensions hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of two-storey front / side extension to existing house with two front roof dormers and one side roof dormer, part width two-storey rear element with roof accommodation, and three-storey tower (turret) to rear and; erection of one front and one rear roof dormer to existing house, single-storey rear extension, internal alterations, and verandah to front across existing house and proposed extension.
